data.name: Prakashan
data.gender_notes: Prakashan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Prakashan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prakash' which means 'Light'. This name is associated with the idea of illuminating knowledge and is believed to bring prosperity and success. The name Prakashan carries the meaning “Light, Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Prakashan usually hope their child will grow to embody light, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prakashan is a name of the Hindu deity Vishnu. It represents the power of illumination and knowledge. The name is believed to bring prosperity and success.
data.etymology: Prakashan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prakashan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

By giving this name to a child, the parents are wishing for him/her to be a beacon of knowledge, a source of light for others in their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, there is a belief that the soul is a divine spark of light. The name Prakashan reflects this spiritual belief, as it connects the individual to the divine light within themselves. It also signifies the idea of enlightenment, or the process of seeking and gaining a deeper understanding of the self and the universe.
